title: Roberto Mancini returns as Italy head coach with Claudio Ranieri named technical director
excerpt: Roberto Mancini has agreed to coach Italy again, three years after stepping down, in the wake of Andrea Pirlo being rejected
content_html:
Roberto Mancini has agreed to be Italy head coach for a second time, the president of the Italian Football ​Federation (FIGC), Giovanni Malagò, said on Tuesday, also confirming Claudio Ranieri would take over as technical director.

Mancini replaces Gennaro Gattuso, who ⁠left the post in April after Italy failed to qualify for a third World Cup in succession, and returns to a job he held between 2018 and 2023. He led the national team to European Championship glory in 2021 with a penalty shootout victory over England at Wembley but then failed to reach the 2022 World Cup and a slow start to Euro 2024 qualifying. In total, Mancini managed Italy for 58 matches during his first spell and at club level has managed Inter, Fiorentina and Manchester City, where he spent three years and guided them to their first Premier League title in 2011-12.

“Mancini is the coach,” Malago ‌said on Tuesday. “I believed that the best person to become head coach was ‌Roberto Mancini.”

The former FIGC technical director ‌Paolo Maldini and his adviser, Leonardo, resigned from their roles on Monday after Andrea Pirlo’s appointment as head coach was blocked because of the former midfielder’s ties to a Russian betting firm. Pep Guardiola was the association’s first choice but turned down the job last month.

Ranieri replaces ⁠Maldini. The 74-year-old, who led Leicester City to the Premier League title in ​2016, will oversee technical operations and ​elite football development across Italy’s national team structures. “I needed someone with ​whom I could share ‌the decision on ​the coach, because ​without that shared view my reasoning would have carried little weight,” Malago said. “So consequently, we have a new coach and a new technical director for Italy.”

content_html_zh:
意大利足球联合会（FIGC）主席乔瓦尼·马拉戈周二表示，罗伯托·曼奇尼已同意第二次担任意大利主教练，并确认克劳迪奥·拉涅利将接任技术总监。

曼奇尼接替了因意大利连续三届世界杯未能晋级而于四月份离职的加图索，并重返他在 2018 年至 2023 年期间担任的职位。 他带领国家队在温布利点球大战中战胜英格兰队夺得2021年欧洲杯冠军，但随后未能进入2022年世界杯，并且在2024年欧洲杯预选赛中开局缓慢。 曼奇尼在他的第一个任期内总共执教了意大利队58场比赛，并在俱乐部层面执教过国际米兰、佛罗伦萨和曼城，他在曼城效力了三年，并带领他们在2011-12赛季首次夺得英超冠军。

“曼奇尼是教练，”马拉戈周二表示。 “我相信成为主教练的最佳人选是罗伯托·曼奇尼。”

由于前中场球员安德烈亚·皮尔洛与一家俄罗斯博彩公司的关系，其主教练的任命被阻止，前意大利足联技术总监保罗·马尔蒂尼和他的顾问莱昂纳多于周一辞去职务。 瓜迪奥拉是该协会的首选，但上个月拒绝了这份工作。

拉涅利换下马尔蒂尼。 这位 74 岁的老人曾在 2016 年带领莱斯特城夺得英超冠军，他将负责意大利国家队结构的技术运营和精英足球发展。 “我需要一个可以与我分享对教练的决定的人，因为如果没有这种共同的观点，我的推理就没有什么意义，”马拉戈说。 “因此，我们为意大利队带来了一位新教练和一位新技术总监。”
